capital_movements_allocation_consistent.name: capital_movements_allocation_consistent
capital_movements_allocation_consistent.value: ("capital_movements"."type" = 'ADDITION' and "capital_movements"."profit_portion" = 0 and "capital_movements"."capital_portion" = 0) or ("capital_movements"."type" = 'WITHDRAWAL' and "capital_movements"."profit_portion" >= 0 and "capital_movements"."capital_portion" >= 0 and "capital_movements"."profit_portion" + "capital_movements"."capital_portion" = "capital_movements"."amount")

capital_movements_void_state_consistent.name: capital_movements_void_state_consistent
capital_movements_void_state_consistent.value: ("capital_movements"."status" = 'ACTIVE' and "capital_movements"."voided_at" is null and "capital_movements"."voided_by" is null) or ("capital_movements"."status" = 'VOIDED' and "capital_movements"."voided_at" is not null and "capital_movements"."voided_by" is not null and length(trim(coalesce("capital_movements"."void_reason", ''))) > 0)

shifts_closed_state_consistent.name: shifts_closed_state_consistent
shifts_closed_state_consistent.value: ("shifts"."status" = 'OPEN' and "shifts"."closed_at" is null) or ("shifts"."status" = 'CLOSED' and "shifts"."closed_at" is not null)

stock_receipts_cost_fields_consistent.name: stock_receipts_cost_fields_consistent
stock_receipts_cost_fields_consistent.value: ("stock_receipts"."supplier_id" is null and "stock_receipts"."unit_cost" is null and "stock_receipts"."total_cost" is null) or ("stock_receipts"."supplier_id" is not null and "stock_receipts"."unit_cost" > 0 and "stock_receipts"."total_cost" = "stock_receipts"."unit_cost" * "stock_receipts"."quantity")

supplier_payments_void_state_consistent.name: supplier_payments_void_state_consistent
supplier_payments_void_state_consistent.value: ("supplier_payments"."status" = 'ACTIVE' and "supplier_payments"."voided_at" is null and "supplier_payments"."voided_by" is null) or ("supplier_payments"."status" = 'VOIDED' and "supplier_payments"."voided_at" is not null and "supplier_payments"."voided_by" is not null and length(trim(coalesce("supplier_payments"."void_reason", ''))) > 0)
